name: The Temptation Gradient
description: Twenty-seven verified-answerable tasks across five temptation axes at three graded levels, for measuring false-exit rates in agents given a legitimate task-bail channel. Reference results: 0 false exits in 648 calls; 95% upper bound 0.96% at the highest temptation level against a pre-registered 5% margin. Copyright © 2026 AiSSAY, Inc.
